dedupe_keys.name: anylogic multimethod simulation software desktop and anylogic online

description: AnyLogic is commercial simulation modelling software for business and engineering systems, offered as a desktop environment and as AnyLogic Online in the browser with the same functionality. The pages read on 2026-09-26 say it supports multimethod modelling, meaning agent-based, discrete event and system dynamics models, with industry libraries for material handling, road traffic, pedestrians, rail, fluids and bulk materials and process modelling, GIS map integration, optimisation, Monte Carlo, sensitivity, calibration and reinforcement learning experiments, and deployment of models as digital twins or enterprise solutions through APIs. It is made by The AnyLogic Company; the latest version, 8.9.10, was released on 24 September 2026. The Personal Learning Edition is a free licence for evaluation and personal use, limited to 10 agent types and 50,000 dynamic agents, while the University Researcher and Professional editions are paid on a quote, with no price stated. Industries listed include manufacturing, supply chains, mining and metals, oil and gas, ports, rail and road traffic. Caveats: it is closed source, and the free edition cannot export standalone applications. For simulation it is used to model plant logistics, supply chain disruption and evacuation of industrial sites. Related catalogue records include the case study of the Gloucestershire hospital digital twin.
